main.title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia After President Trump Intervenes
main.summary: Mr. Trump, a close ally of Mr. Huang, led a campaign to assure the chip company’s board that the longtime chief executive did not present a national security risk.

related.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
related.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

related.title: Does Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia mean the chip group is too big to fail?
related.summary: Nvidia gains nearly $1tn in value after Jensen Huang reinstated

related.title: Stocks climb as Huang's return to Nvidia lifts investor optimism
related.summary: Shares in AI chip behemoth Nvidia rocketed 30% higher on Monday after the shock reinstatement of its CEO Jensen Huang, which sparked a recovery across markets after a technology-led rout last week.

related.title: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia. What does it mean for Europe's AI stocks?
related.summary: Europe's chip stocks rallied after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, with Donald Trump cheering the board's decision. But Nokia, ASML and other AI names have only recovered part of what they lost during his absence.

0731519049.topic: Jensen Huang torna CEO di Nvidia dopo l'intervento di Trump, rally dei mercati
0731519049.reason: La decisione del board si ribalta: Huang torna CEO, Nvidia guadagna quasi 1.000 miliardi di dollari di valore e le borse si riprendono in tutto il mondo, Europa compresa. Molte testate la riprendono e restano aperte le polemiche sul ruolo di Trump e sulla sicurezza nazionale.
